title: cached_db must stay schema-only; per-test db_uri copies own the Default experiment
answers: why does the cached sqlite test database have no experiments
where is the Default experiment created for tests using db_uri
add a test fixture that needs a Default experiment in sqlite
body:
Invariant: The session-scoped cached_db in tests/conftest.py must contain only schema and migrations, with no experiment rows.
Enforced by: tests/conftest.py:db_uri inserts experiment_id DEFAULT_EXPERIMENT_ID with artifact_location under the test's tmp_dir, using the experiments table columns (name, artifact_location, lifecycle_stage, creation_time, last_update_time, workspace).
What breaks if skipped: Copies that get no Default row let the store create one under ./mlruns, reintroducing shared-directory artifact cleanup races. Updating experiment 0's artifact_location in the copy matches zero rows, since the cache no longer has that row.
Constraints: Any new per-test database setup should copy the cache and then insert its own Default experiment rather than writing into cached_db.
applies: tests/conftest.py database fixtures; does not apply to production store code.
says: Automated test runs are randomly failing due to file cleanup conflicts in shared directories.
Database integration tests cannot find the default experiment when querying test database copies.
Database updates targeting experiment zero fail because the test database copy is empty.
Prevent parallel test executions from creating artifacts in shared default experiment folders.
search: The session-scoped cached_db fixture in tests/conftest.py must contain only database schema and migrations without any experiment rows. Individual test database copies created via tests/conftest.py:db_uri insert DEFAULT_EXPERIMENT_ID with artifact_location pointing to the test tmp_dir. If copies lack a Default experiment row, the store creates one under ./mlruns, introducing shared-directory artifact cleanup races. New per-test fixtures must copy cached_db and create their own Default experiment rather than writing directly into cached_db.
